info.name: MaintainX Asset Criticalities Meter Readings API

params.name: skipWebhook
params.description: Set `skipWebhook=true`, `skipWebhook=1` or `skipWebhook=yes` to skip all webhooks upon successful operation on the endpoint. [Learn more about webhooks](#tag/Subscriptions-and-Webhooks)

items.docs:
We strongly recommend using this endpoint to create meter readings since it is more efficient.

Rate Limits

  • For Automated and IoT meter readings: 100 requests / 60 seconds
  • For Manual meter readings: 10 requests / 24 hours
